overview.text:
**Changed**
- `index.js`: new `matchEntityRegExp` matches `"|&|<|>|&#dec;|&#[xX]hex;`, so a semicolon is required and names are case-sensitive [E5, H3].
- `index.js:unescapeHtml`: coerces input with `'' + string`, maps named entities, and parses numeric references with `parseInt` [H5].
- `unescapeHtml` returns the entity unchanged when the code point is >0x10FFFF or in 0xD800–0xDFFF. Above 0xFFFF it emits a surrogate pair [H5].
- `'` is decoded by the decimal path, not by a named case [H5].
- `index.js` exports the function as `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml` [H4].
- `README.md`: the intro is reworded and a new `escapeHtml.unescape(string)` section covers semantics and an example [H1, H2].

**Why**
- The user asked for a dependency-free inverse of `escapeHtml` that leaves unknown and invalid references intact, with node:test tests and README docs [E1].
- The agent stated it would first inspect how `escapeHtml` is exported, then add the export [E2].
- No reasons are stated for the regex-based design or for rejecting surrogates. Not shown.

**Tests**
- New `test/unescape.test.js` has 10 `test()` cases [H6]:
  - export check, and a round trip `unescape(escapeHtml(original))` [H6]
  - decimal references, including `<`; hex references with `x`/`X` and mixed case [H6]
  - supplementary characters and boundaries (`` → `\uDBFF\uDFFF`) [H6]
  - invalid values left unchanged: `�`, surrogates, 40-digit overflow [H6]
  - unknown or wrong-case names unchanged (`©`, `&`, `&constructor;`) [H6]
  - malformed input unchanged (`&amp` with no `;`, `&#;`, `&#-1;`, `&#xGG;`) [H6]
  - single-layer decoding (`&lt;` → `<`), and coercion of `undefined`, `null`, `42`, `{}`, and a custom `toString` [H6]
- `node --test test/unescape.test.js` exited 0. The output is truncated; the agent reports 10 passing [E5, E9].
- `npm test` exited 127 because `mocha` was not found [E6].
- The existing `test/index.js` was run through a `node:test` describe/it shim: 30 passed [E8].

**Risks**
- The existing suite was never run under mocha, its real runner [E6, E8].
- The full `node --test` output is truncated, so the per-test pass list is not shown [E5].
- Agent assumptions:
  - surrogate code points are treated as invalid, which goes beyond the user's single example (`�`) [E1, H5]
  - `�` decodes to NUL [H6]
- An earlier exploration command exited 1, likely because the `rg` search for AGENTS.md found nothing (not shown) [E4].
- Unrelated changes: the README intro sentence was rewritten; nothing else outside the request is shown [H1].

mechanism.text:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["require('escape-html').unescape"] --> B["unescapeHtml(string)"]
  B -->|"'' + string coercion"| C["str.replace(matchEntityRegExp, cb)"]
  C -->|"no match: unknown/malformed/no semicolon"| D["text left unchanged"]
  C -->|"match: entity, decimal, hex"| E["switch(entity)"]
  E -->|"" & < >"| F["return literal char"]
  E -->|"numeric ref"| G["parseInt(decimal,10) or parseInt(hex,16)"]
  G --> H{"codePoint > 0x10FFFF or 0xD800..0xDFFF?"}
  H -->|"yes"| I["return entity as-is"]
  H -->|"no, <= 0xFFFF"| J["String.fromCharCode(codePoint)"]
  H -->|"no, > 0xFFFF"| K["surrogate pair: 0xD800+(cp>>10), 0xDC00+(cp&0x3FF)"]
  F --> L["single-pass result string"]
  J --> L
  K --> L
  I --> L
```

- `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml` attaches the function as a property, so `module.exports` is still `escapeHtml` [H4].
- `unescapeHtml` coerces input with `'' + string`. Tests show `undefined`/`null`/`42`/`{}` become strings, and a custom `toString` returning `<` decodes to `<` [H5, H6].
- `matchEntityRegExp` only matches `"|&|<|>|&#digits;|&#[xX]hex;` with a required `;`. The match is case-sensitive [H3].
- Inputs that don't match stay as they are. Tests cover `©`, `&`, `&constructor;`, `&#x;`, `&#-1;`, `&#12a;`, and `&lt` without `;` [H6].
- `'` has no named case. It goes through the decimal capture to `String.fromCharCode(39)` [H3, H5, H6].
- Numeric refs: decimal is parsed base 10 and hex base 16. Tests include `<`, `<` and `'` [H5, H6].
- The validity guard returns the original entity for values above `0x10FFFF` or in the surrogate range. Tests cover `�`, `�`, `�` and a 40-digit decimal [H5, H6].
- For values above `0xFFFF` it builds a surrogate pair. Tests check that `😀`/`😀` give `\uD83D\uDE00` and that `` gives `\uDBFF\uDFFF` [H5, H6].
- A single `replace` pass decodes only one layer: `&lt;` becomes `<` [H5, H6].
- `node --test test/unescape.test.js` exited 0. Legacy escape tests passed (30) under a `node:test` shim. `npm test` failed with exit 127 because mocha is missing [E5, E6, E8].
